title: DOW-UAP-D101, Intelligence Information Report, Unresolved UAP Report, Gulf of Oman, 2021
doc_notes: This is an intelligence information report regarding UAP observations by a USSOF AC-130 gunship crew, and it contains detailed encounter reports.

encounters.summary: During a live-fire training exercise, an AC-130 gunship crew observed two cold orbs stationary over a flare, which then rapidly departed upon the firing of the aircraft's cannon.
encounters.entity_behavior: stationary, then rapidly flew away without changing altitude
encounters.quote: observed two approximately four-foot diameter cold orbs

encounters.summary: AC-130 crew observed approximately 25 instances of UAPs maneuvering in coordinated formations, including erratic movements and aggressive behavior.
encounters.entity_behavior: coordinated formation, maneuvering like dolphins in a pod, erratic, aggressive
encounters.quote: maneuvering around, over, and under each other in a manner similar to how dolphins playfully swim in a pod
